Audio/video load and format-conversion nodes for ComfyUI. Reads and writes only inside the ComfyUI input/output directories; every path is resolved with realpath and confirmed with commonpath, so absolute paths, '..' traversal and outside symlinks are rejected. Extract the audio track from a video, trim long media by time range, export several formats in one run with parameters auto-adapted to the source, instant same-format passthrough with no re-encoding, a standalone video parameter report, and built-in compliance checks for mainstream Chinese music platforms. English UI by default; a Simplified Chinese translation is available from Interface -> Language.

Files are read from the ComfyUI input directory (drag and drop, or the upload button on the load nodes) and written to the output directory under a relative prefix. Report text follows the interface language by default and can be pinned per node.

custom_nodes.author: jesse890423
custom_nodes.title: ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS-5x
custom_nodes.description:
Speech synthesis, voice cloning and voice design nodes for Qwen3-TTS, patched for transformers 5.x (verified on 5.14.1 / ComfyUI 0.37.0 / torch 2.13.0).

Fork of flybirdxx/ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS v1.0.7, which declares transformers>=4.57.0,<5.0.0. This fork adapts the four affected files so the plugin runs on transformers 5.x: pad_token_id no longer copied onto PretrainedConfig, ROPE_INIT_FUNCTIONS['default'] removed, create_causal_mask signature change, cache_position missing on decode (shape crash), and inv_freq left as uninitialised meta memory (silent failure producing wrong-sounding audio).

The folder created under custom_nodes/ is named ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS-5x.

Node CLASS names are identical to upstream (FB_Qwen3TTS*), so the two packages must not be enabled at the same time -- disable or remove one of them. If you need the original 4.x behaviour, install flybirdxx/ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS pinned to transformers 4.57.3.

License: Apache-2.0 (code). Model weights are not included and remain under the Qwen3-TTS License Agreement from Alibaba Cloud.
